credential_id.description: Stored credential from the source connect page, for the item's PostHog source type.

destination_ids.description: Destinations to write the new source to. Omit to write to the PostHog warehouse.

item_id.description: The migration item to create a PostHog source for.

prefix.description: Table name prefix to use instead of the planned one, for example when the planned one is taken.

table_overrides.description: Changes to the planned tables that the user confirmed: rename an inferred pair, map an unmatched table, or leave a table out.

posthog_table.description: The PostHog table to sync it as. Null leaves the table out.

vendor_table.description: A Fivetran table from the item: a planned table's `vendor_table`, or one of `unmatched_tables`.
